title: 12 Best Tea Houses in Accra
description: Discover Accra's best tea houses, from serene garden cafes to bustling urban spots. Find where to enjoy the finest brews, pastries, and ambiance in Ghana's vibrant capital.

places.name: Cafe Kwae
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their English Breakfast Tea paired with the 'Chai Spiced French Toast' for a delightful balance of flavors.

places.name: Zen Garden
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pot of Jasmine Green Tea with their 'Thai Green Curry' spring rolls for a flavorful light meal.

places.name: Capitol Cafe & Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'High Tea Set' for a full experience, featuring a selection of teas, savory bites, and sweet treats.

places.name: Chocolate Sarayi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A traditional Turkish Black Tea ('Cay') alongside their famous 'Chocolate Soufflé' or 'Kunefe'.

places.name: Bloom Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Matcha Latte' if you're feeling adventurous, or a classic 'Earl Grey' with one of their fresh 'Açaí Bowls'.

places.name: Living Room by Glendara
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A calming 'Chamomile Infusion' with their 'Almond Croissant' for a peaceful afternoon treat.

places.name: Kona Cafe & Grill
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order An 'Iced Peach Tea' on a hot day, accompanied by their 'Chicken Caesar Salad' for a refreshing lunch.

places.name: Josmo @ The Mix
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A refreshing glass of 'Sobolo' (chilled hibiscus tea) and one of their freshly baked 'Meat Pies'.

places.name: Sunshine Salad Bar & Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order An 'Organic Peppermint Tea' with their 'Build-Your-Own Salad' for a truly revitalizing meal.

places.name: Vida e Caffè
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic 'Rooibos Tea' (red bush tea) with a freshly baked 'Muffin'.

places.name: Second Cup Coffee Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'London Fog' (Earl Grey tea latte) for a comforting and creamy treat, paired with a 'Cheesecake Slice'.

places.name: Pinocchio Gelato & Espresso
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A simple 'Black Tea' to balance the richness of their 'Pistachio Gelato' or a 'Tiramisu'.
